g.text: PMM gains differ across individual events

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #4d5660

g.text: All 13 episodes retained • Monthly forecasts at leads 1–9 • No event-specific tuning
1986–88 includes starts in 1986 and 1987; 2014–16 includes starts in 2014 and 2015.
Each sustained episode counts once in group averages. All other episodes have five starts (45 monthly pairs).
RO uses total WWV26; both models use the same ERSST target and leave-one-event-out training mask.
